title: AddDescribeData
description:
The FIRST-TRUST describe a bare `add` of a NEW git source returns: the source, what was
discovered in it, and exactly what would be written where — nothing has landed. `--yes`
applies. **INFERRED** (additive-only).

manifest.description: The manifest FILE the row would land in.

members.description: The skills discovered in it (leaf directory names).

reference.description: The row key that would be written.

source.description: The source being trusted for the first time (e.g. `github.com/<owner>/<repo>`).

value.description: The row value that would be written (`"*"` or a commit pin).
